newsitem.title: USA: Iowa unemployment rate rose 0.1 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Iowa unemployment rate rose 0.1 pct in April.

text.p: Iowa's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose 0.1 percent in April to 3.3 percent, but below the 3.7 percent rate of a year ago, the Iowa Workforce Development Department reported Thursday.

Seasonally adjusted non-farm employment increased for the seventh consecutive month in April, running from 5,200 to 1.4 million due to growth in construction, services and nondurable goods manufacturing, the department reported.

Eight states reported lower unemployment rates than Iowa in the first quarter of 1997, including six in the middle section of the country: Indiana, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wisconsin, the department said. Four states had reported lower jobless rates than Iowa in the first quarter of 1996.
The U.S. unemployment rate dropped from 5.2 percent in March to 4.9 percent in April, down from 5.5 percent in April 1996.
